QUESTION:
In PaderQueue 4.x, what does `metrics.interval_s` default to?

DOCUMENTATION EXCERPTS:
[d0171] config | metrics.interval_s | version 4.x
# `metrics.interval_s`

> Configuration reference for PaderQueue 4.x (current).

Interval in seconds between two background runs of the metrics exporter that exposes Prometheus metrics.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | integer |
| Default | `10` |
| Available since | 1.0 |
| Component | metrics |
| Unit | s |
| Default changed | in 3.0 (see release notes) |

## When to change it

The default works for most deployments. Change `metrics.interval_s` only if you observe problems with the metrics exporter that exposes Prometheus metrics, for example in the metrics dashboard.

Set it in `paderqueue.toml`:

```toml
[metrics]
interval_s = 10
```

---

[d0606] config | metrics.interval_s (PaderQueue 2.x) | version 2.x
# `metrics.interval_s` (PaderQueue 2.x)

> Configuration reference for PaderQueue 2.x.

Interval in seconds between two background runs of the metrics exporter that exposes Prometheus metrics.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | integer |
| Default | `300` |
| Available since | 1.0 |
| Component | metrics |
| Unit | s |

## Notes

Changes to `metrics.interval_s` take effect after restarting the node. In clusters, use the same value on all nodes.

Set it in `paderqueue.toml`:

```toml
[metrics]
interval_s = 300
```
